title: Scope.
officialText: The provisions of this chapter shall govern the structural design of buildings, structures and portions thereof regulated by this code. (Note: Where the text in this Code refers to ASCE 7, the 2005 edition shall be used; and where the text in this Code refers to ASCE 7-10, the 2010 edition shall be used.)
